guvenlik.aciklama: Which devices accounts are signed in from and when they were last used. You can end a suspicious session or sign a user out of every device; raw IPs are never stored, only a hash is shown.
guvenlik.kapatOnay: End the “{{cihaz}}” session? That device will have to sign in again right away.

cikar.aciklama: All of the user's open sessions are ended and every sign-in token issued so far becomes invalid (including sessions opened the old way). The user can continue by signing in again.
cikar.onay: Sign {{eposta}} out of every device? All of their open sessions will end immediately.
cikar.basarili: {{eposta}} was signed out everywhere ({{sayi}} sessions ended).

hataKod.kendi_oturumun: You can't end the session you are using right now from here; sign out instead.
hataKod.kendi_hesabin: Signing your own account out everywhere would end this session too. For your other devices, use “End all other sessions” on your profile.
hataKod.genel: The action could not be completed; please try again.

kisi.aciklama: Devices where your account is signed in. If you see a session you don't recognise, end it right away.
kisi.digerleriOnay: End all of your sessions except this device?
kisi.digerleriYok: There are no other sessions to end.
kisi.buCihazOnay: Ending the session on this device signs you out. Continue?
kisi.eskiOturum: Your session on this device was opened the old way; it will appear here after your next sign-in.

csp.aciklama: The site's Content Security Policy (CSP) is enforced. Browsers report every resource the policy blocks here; the latest 500 distinct violations are kept and a repeat within an hour increases the counter. An empty list means all is well; a new analytics or ad domain, or a changed inline script, shows up here.
